title: Lease basics

captions.instagram:
Rent is only one line of your lease. Term, renewal, exit, buildout, extra costs and restrictions all shape your business. I listed what to weigh, and six questions for your landlord.

General guidance, not legal advice: have a qualified lawyer review any lease before you sign.

#SmallBusiness #CommercialRealEstate #Retail

What question would you add?
captions.facebook:
Before you sign a lease, look past the rent. I listed what to weigh and six questions to ask your landlord.

General guidance, not legal advice. Always have a lawyer review the lease.

#SmallBusiness #CommercialRealEstate

What's one lease term you wish you'd negotiated?
captions.linkedin:
The lease is part of your business model, not a formality.

What I'd weigh first: rent against realistic traffic and sales, the term, renewal rights and cost, and what happens if the location doesn't work. Then check buildout contributions, costs on top of base rent, and restrictions on what you can sell, display or change.

Review, negotiate, sign, in that order, with a qualified lawyer.

General guidance, not legal advice.
